The '''Unified Legislature''' was the body of government formed by the [[Civilized and the Workers]]. It replaced the [[Civilized Authority]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Call to Vengeance]]'' it is mistakenly called the United Legislature. This was later corrected in future ''Jedi Apprentice'' novels.
